scope: Primary-source comparison for private checkpoint content admission; no KVM capture, persistent publication or restore acceptance

observations.upstream: Guest memory and VMM state are separate outputs; drives are managed by the integrator. Memory backing remains required throughout a restored VMM lifetime.
observations.implementation: Three distinct typed content roles; exact hashes/lengths and independent anonymous inodes; no source pathname/liveness prerequisite for bytes.

observations.upstream: Snapshot creation opens state output with create/write/truncate and releases it after serialization and optional sync; the documented output paths can be overwritten.
observations.implementation: No direct Ready-content path is supplied to snapshot/create. This increment accepts only a pinned content reference and creates unnamed private copies, with no named-partial fallback.

observations.upstream: Snapshots require Paused; sync_snapshot_files defaults true and disk draining/sync are separate from host storage lifecycle.
observations.implementation: The typed protocol3 completed barrier and exact runtime are metadata predicates only. Actual paused capture, producer fencing, shared reservation, manifest-last durable publication and source collection remain unimplemented.

local_evidence_limits: Portable manifest provenance is synthetic. Linux filesystem tests, once passed on the exact source, observe actual bytes, sparse copies, source deletion, read-only descriptors and refusal cleanup only. Newer sources are not accepted by the b18bd35 same-VMM gate.
